findings.title: pre-edit.sh names .claude/rules/ as the source of .cursor/rules and sends seats to edit a generated copy
findings.claim: pre-edit.sh's header (line 14) and its .cursor/rules refusal (lines 94-97) say the Cursor rules are generated from .claude/rules/ and tell the seat to edit that source and regenerate, but rules_sync.mjs generates both .claude/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ from dev/governance/rules/, so an edit made where the hook says is discarded by the regeneration (edit_reaches_cursor=0) and the hook lets that generated directory through (unguarded_generated=1).
findings.mechanism: R9-RO-5 moved the canonical rules to dev/governance/rules/ and made .claude/rules/ a second generated output (tools/policy/rules_sync.mjs SRC/CLAUDE_OUT/CURSOR_OUT); the hook's comment, refusal text and guard still describe the pre-move layout, and its self-test pins the stale reading ('the SOURCE rule is allowed', .claude/rules/gate-scoping.md).

findings.metric_definition: edit_reaches_cursor: 1 if a line planted in the dir the hook's refusal names as source survives rules_sync.mjs regeneration into .cursor/rules/<rule>.mdc, else 0
findings.phenomenon_property: Every directory a hook comment or refusal names as the source of a generated file is the directory the generator reads, and every generator output directory is refused by the hook.

findings.title: stop-selfcheck.sh's policy prefix list misses AGENTS.md and dev/audit/README.md, which policy_lint measures
findings.claim: stop-selfcheck.sh's comments say POLICY_PREFIXES covers 'the paths whose contents policy_lint ... measure' (the same set, lines 11-13 and 24-27), but 2 of the 65 baseline files POLICY_GLOBS measures (AGENTS.md, dev/audit/README.md) do not match it, so a turn touching only those ends with no lint (e2e rc 0 against a red linter where CLAUDE.md gives 2); the header's 'runs only when the branch's three-dot diff touches' is also false (an uncommitted edit runs it).
findings.mechanism: The prefix list is a second, hand-kept definition of policy_lint.mjs's POLICY_GLOBS; AGENTS.md was added to the globs and the harness contract moved from tools/audit/README.md to dev/audit/README.md without the list following. The #1547 change widened CHANGED to worktree, index and untracked without updating the header.

findings.title: 339 comment sentences over 40 words across 193 of 329 cell files (criterion C5)
findings.claim: Counted within prose paragraphs only (list items, RESULT lines and indentation steps split apart), 339 sentences in the D5 units of the seat's 329 files exceed the 40-word ceiling D5-criteria.md C5 sets, in 193 files; the hooks alone carry examples of 41-53 words (pre-edit.sh lines 4-7, 34-40, 211-216).
findings.mechanism: Comments accrete narrative history (who measured, which PR) inside a single sentence joined by dashes and semicolons; no lint bounds sentence length.
